Inventaris van deze cluster nakijken: Review the inventory of this cluster
Deze APs ondersteunen AOS-10 niet. Verva: These APs do not support AOS-10. Replace them with an AOS-10 model before or during the migration; add the new ones to GreenLake and Central before you start.
Zolang ze er hangen, vallen ze uit zodra: As long as they are installed, they go offline as soon as their controller moves to AOS-10.
Los dit op of beslis wat ermee gebeurt,: Fix this or decide what happens to it, so that after the migration you do not have to work out whether an AP is missing because of the migration or was already missing.
Site en device group in Central: Site and device group in Central
Zet de sites voor deze AP-groepen klaar: Prepare the sites for these AP groups and choose the device group for the APs and for the gateways of this cluster. Assign the serial numbers in GreenLake/Central to the right site and group already, so they land in the right place straight away.
Zet in de device group van de gateways:: Set in the gateways' device group: management IP per gateway (you can reuse the controller's IP), default gateway, DNS, NTP, the uplink (trunk with the user VLANs of the tunneled SSIDs) and the cluster settings.
Bewaar de configuratie van de conductor: Save the configuration of the conductor and of these controllers, and an AP list of this cluster as a reference for checking afterwards.
In stappen: de getunnelde SSID's blijven: Step by step: the tunneled SSIDs stay available, but roaming between APs on AOS-8 and AOS-10 is not seamless. Convert the APs per building or floor and inform the users.
Deze cluster heeft maar een controller:: This cluster has only one controller: as soon as it moves to AOS-10, the APs on AOS-8 lose their tunnel. Plan a maintenance window for the controller and APs together, or first set up a temporary gateway in Central and migrate the APs to it.
Reken op uitval van het draadloze netwer: Expect the wireless network to be down during the window.
Haal {naam} uit de AOS-8-cluster zodat a: Take {naam} out of the AOS-8 cluster so that all APs move to {andere}. Check that no APs are left on {naam}.
Verwijder {naam} van de conductor, laad: Remove {naam} from the conductor, load the AOS-10 image, erase the configuration and restart. The gateway registers with Central through GreenLake.
Exacte commando's en volgorde nakijken i: Check the exact commands and order in HPE's migration guide for your AOS-8 version.
De gateway staat online in Central, op d: The gateway is online in Central, at the right site and in this cluster's device group, with the right firmware. The configuration was pushed without errors, the uplink and VLANs are up, and the cluster is formed.
Laat AOS-8 nakijken of de APs AOS-10 en: Let AOS-8 check whether the APs can reach AOS-10 and Central before you convert them.
Pilot: een of twee APs omzetten: Pilot: convert one or two APs
Zet een of twee APs om vanuit de conduct: Convert one or two APs from the conductor and check them fully before you continue: online in Central, AOS-10, right site and group, name, tunnel to the gateway, and a test client per SSID (sign-in, VLAN, IP, internet).
Zet de APs van deze groep om en controle: Convert the APs of this group and then check in Central: number online, names, site, and a test client.
Alle APs van deze cluster op AOS-10: All APs of this cluster on AOS-10
Op AOS-8 staan geen APs meer van deze cl: No APs of this cluster are left on AOS-8; {n} are online in Central (plus the replacements for the APs that could not move).
Nu er geen APs meer op AOS-8 hangen: ver: Now that no APs are left on AOS-8: remove the controller from the conductor and convert it like the first.
Beide gateways staan in dezelfde device: Both gateways are in the same device group and form the cluster together. Each AP has an active and a standby gateway. Test a failover: restart a gateway and check that the clients keep working.
Verwijder de controllers van deze cluste: Remove this cluster's controllers from the conductor and release the AOS-8 licences.
Werk de documentatie bij (namen, IP's, s: Update the documentation (names, IPs, sites) and tell the customer that this cluster is done.
Zolang de laatste controller nog op AOS-: As long as the last controller is still on AOS-8, the APs that have not been converted keep working. Moving an AP that is already on AOS-10 back to AOS-8 requires a firmware downgrade: test that way back in the lab before the first production wave.
bevatten commando's die per AOS-8-versie: contain commands that can differ per AOS-8 version: check them in HPE's migration guide.
Lees eerst de inventaris van deze klant: Read in this customer's inventory first.
twee of meer controllers: in stappen: two or more controllers: step by step
Zet de serienummers van alle APs en cont: Add the serial numbers of all APs and controllers that move over to the customer's GreenLake workspace, assign them to new Central and assign subscriptions: {aps} (without the {nee} that are replaced) and {gateways}. The list of serial numbers is under All APs (Export CSV).
Nieuwe APs ter vervanging van de 200-ree: Also add the new APs that replace the 200 series right away.
Kies een LSR-versie die alle AP- en gate: Choose an LSR version that supports all AP and gateway models. The controllers now run {versies}.
Let op de {n} APs met einde support: hu: Mind the {n} APs with end of support: their last AOS-10 release determines how long you can stay on that version.
Maak de site collections en sites aan (e: Create the site collections and sites (one site per location), a device group for the APs and a device group per gateway cluster. The AP groups from AOS-8 (see AP groups) are the basis for the layout.
Maak in de Library de WLAN-profielen voo: Create in the Library the WLAN profiles for the tunneled SSIDs (forward mode: tunnel to the gateway cluster), the roles, the VLANs on the gateways and the authentication servers (RADIUS/ClearPass). Take the values from the AOS-8 configuration (show wlan virtual-ap, show wlan ssid-profile, show aaa server-group).
Voeg in ClearPass of NPS de nieuwe RADIU: Add the new RADIUS clients in ClearPass or NPS: the IP addresses of the gateways (and of the APs if they authenticate themselves in the profile you choose). Do this before the first wave, otherwise 802.1X fails.
APs en gateways moeten uitgaand HTTPS (4: APs and gateways need outbound HTTPS (443) to Central and GreenLake, and NTP and DNS. Check the firewall and any proxy for the management VLANs of the APs and controllers.
Werkwijze testen in het lab: Test the approach in the lab
Doorloop het volledige plan eerst op een: Run through the whole plan on a lab cluster first: convert a controller, convert an AP, test the SSIDs, and also the way back. Adjust the steps where practice differs.
